purpose: Retain the larger-gap faucet article and its support-release observation.
result: Support removal improved; the reported underside finish is essentially unchanged.
user_observation: The 0.48 mm gap comparison turned out fine. Basically identical to what we've been getting, though the supports did remove easier because they were all joined together.

The exposed inclined face retains distinct uneven strands and gaps between roads.
inference_limit: The photos and removal report do not measure interface force or establish a single thermal or geometric cause.
